lines.maoEnglish:
Monday.
Ordinarily I would have to leave for school soon, but Ciel sternly ordered me not to step outside this room.
Until she returns, I should avoid any contact with the outside world.
I still have to tell Akiha that I won’t be home for a while.
I still have to apologize to Kohaku, though there is no chance she can forgive me.
Leaving both undone weighs heavily on me, but dealing with Roa must come first.
“…………”
I pull the sheet over my head.
With a heavy knot still lodged in my chest, I sink back into sleep.
